title: feat(plugin-detail)!: delete seven unregistered, unmounted exports
body:
Fixes #7192
Clause-②: no

## What this does

Deletes the seven `@object-ui/plugin-detail` components that nothing registered and nothing mounted, by maintainer ruling (relayed by triage on objectui#7192, comment 5819441716). The same PR settles the card that started the census:

Fixes #7175

⚠️ **This narrows a published package's public surface.** `@object-ui/plugin-detail` stops exporting seven components, one helper and fifteen types, and `@object-ui/i18n` drops 22 `detail.*` keys from all ten locale packs. The changeset is `minor` with a **BREAKING** body, never `major` (AGENTS.md §9: the fixed group follows the `@objectstack` major).

| Removed component | Types removed with it |
| --- | --- |
| `CommentInput` | `CommentInputProps` |
| `DiffView` | `DiffViewProps`, `DiffFieldType`, `DiffMode`, `DiffLine` |
| `InlineCreateRelated` | `InlineCreateRelatedProps`, `RelatedFieldDefinition`, `RelatedRecordOption` |
| `MentionAutocomplete` (+ value `createMentionFromSuggestion`) | `MentionAutocompleteProps`, `MentionSuggestionItem` |
| `PointInTimeRestore` | `PointInTimeRestoreProps`, `RevisionEntry` |
| `RecordNavigationEnhanced` | `RecordNavigationEnhancedProps` |
| `RelationshipGraph` | `RelationshipGraphProps`, `GraphNode` |

Kept on purpose: `RichTextCommentInput` and its `MentionSuggestion` type (the composer `RecordActivityTimeline` mounts), `RecordComments` (`DetailView` mounts it), `extractMentions`.

Migration (in the changeset): no replacement. An external user copies the component source from a release tag that still ships it; `@object-ui/plugin-detail@17.5.0` was checked to contain all seven files (`git cat-file -e`, 7 of 7 exit 0, a missing-file control exit 128). A real consumer later gets a new card.

## The diff

- **The seven component files and their own tests are deleted**: `PointInTimeRestore.i18n.test.tsx` and the four `__tests__/InlineCreateRelated.*.test.tsx`. The other five components had no test of their own.
- **Barrel** (`packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`): the value and type exports listed above are gone.
- **i18n**: the keys only these components read leave all ten packs and `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`. That is 22 keys, not the 17 the dispatch assumed (see Measurements):
  - `PointInTimeRestore`'s 10 from objectui#7163;
  - `emptyValue`, an older key whose last reader was `PointInTimeRestore`;
  - `DiffView`'s 5;
  - `RecordNavigationEnhanced`'s 6.
  - Keys shared with surfaces that stay are kept: `recordOf`, `noRecords`, `cancel`, `activityEmptyValue`, and the relative-time keys.
- **Text that named the deleted files**:
  - `detailTimestamps.displayLocale-9786.test.tsx` loses its `PointInTimeRestore` and `DiffView` rows, fixtures and imports. Its header now says why those rows left.
  - The three comments that cited `InlineCreateRelated.closeButtonName.test.tsx` (`close-label.tsx` and two `components` tests) now keep only the live example.
  - The `useDetailTranslation.ts` `PointInTimeRestore` comment is gone with its block.
  - An `app-shell` test comment called the composer `CommentInput`'s textarea. It is `RichTextCommentInput` as `RecordActivityTimeline` mounts it, and the comment now says so.
- **Docs**:
  - `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` stops teaching `CommentInput`, `MentionAutocomplete` and `CommentInputProps`. This edit was required, not cosmetic: see the ablation below.
  - `docs/audits/2026-09-plugin-detail-downstream-consumer-census.md` gains a dated "Conclusion (2026-09-24)" section: the ruling, how the open populations closed, and a pointer to this PR through objectui#7192 and this branch. The PR number is not written into the doc because this body is written once, before the number exists.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/7192-retire-seven-unmounted-detail-exports.md`: `minor` for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/i18n`, marked BREAKING, listing every removed export and key, with the migration.

## Measurements (base `9ec8ceba0`)

- **Census, re-run with its control.** Command: `git grep -lw NAME -- 'packages/*/src/*' 'apps/*' 'examples/*'`. The control `RecordComments` lights `DetailView.tsx`. Mounts for each of the seven: **0**.
  - Every non-own hit was a comment, the 9786 test's rows, or the locale packs' objectui#7163 comment.
  - Outside source, the only teaching surface was `plugin-detail.mdx`.
  - `skills/`, `apps/` and all package `README`s: zero hits. `ROADMAP.md` and CHANGELOGs are history.
- **Registration**: `plugin-detail` makes 16 `ComponentRegistry.register` calls, and none registers any of the seven. No other package names them.
- **i18n keys**: each key was grepped repo-wide outside the packs before deletion, and a key read anywhere else stayed. The dead-keys report was read before and after:
  - Before the `emptyValue` step, `detail.emptyValue` appeared as a NEW candidate. That is how it was found.
  - After it, the candidate set equals base exactly: 336 = 336, set diff empty.
  - `en` pack keys went from 3053 to 3031.
- **Nothing else is orphaned**:
  - The seven import only external packages plus `useDetailTranslation`, which stays live.
  - `Mention` (`@object-ui/types`) lost its only importer outside `packages/types`, but `FeedItem.mentions` still references it.

## Verification, at head `ecfb362b3`

All runs below are at `ecfb362b3`, the final commit.

- **Tests**:
  - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/ packages/i18n/` (repo root): `Test Files 271 passed | 1 skipped (272)`, `Tests 3183 passed | 8 skipped`. The skipped file is the pre-existing `skipIf` in `summaryChip.dateOnlyZone-10183`.
  - `scripts/__tests__/` together with every test that reads a touched file as text: `Test Files 199 passed | 2 skipped (201)`, `Tests 5799 passed | 2 skipped`. Those tests are `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack`, the dialog-close i18n suites, `registry-inputs-spec-parity`, the `types` parity suites, and the rest found with `git grep` for the touched paths.
- **Type-check** (after `turbo run build` of all packages; every task was a turbo cache miss that executed): `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/i18n`, and every importer of plugin-detail (`app-shell`, `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-tree`, `console`, `example-console-starter`). All exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the edited 9786 test.
- **Reverse verification** (one-shot, removed afterwards): a probe file in `plugin-grid` imported `RecordComments`, `PointInTimeRestore` and `RevisionEntry` from `@object-ui/plugin-detail`.
  - `tsc` returned exit 2, with exactly two errors, both `TS2305 has no exported member` (`PointInTimeRestore`, `RevisionEntry`).
  - The control `RecordComments` resolved. There were 0 errors elsewhere.
  - The probe was removed by a trap, and `git status` is clean.
  - So the consumers read the rebuilt `.d.ts`.
- **Docs ablation** (one-shot, restored): with the base `plugin-detail.mdx` restored over the edit, `check-doc-snippet-types` exits 1 with `TS2305 ... has no exported member 'CommentInputProps'` on that page. The restore was proven by blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- **Named gates**, each exit 0:
  - `check:readme-exports`: OK, 546 real, 0 fabricated.
  - `check:i18n-keys`: every call-site key resolves, 3031 keys.
  - `check:i18n-dead-keys`: report-only; set equals base.
  - `check:unreferenced-sources`: OK.
  - `check:control-bytes`: OK.
  - `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
  - `check-changeset-presence`: 1 changeset declared.
  - `check:changeset-claims`: report-only, see Acceptance notes.
  - `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite` (no pending changeset modified) and `check-changeset-fixed`.
  - `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `docs:check-links`.
  - `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, `check:dist-completeness`, `check:published-dist`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:sdui-registration-pins`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`.
- **Governed surface**: `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 32 changed paths says NOT GOVERNED. Its control, `AGENTS.md`, returns exit 3.
- **eslint** over the 20 surviving touched files: 0 errors. No rule's count went up against base. Warnings went down: `react-refresh/only-export-components` on `index.tsx` is 30 at base and 29 now.
- `pnpm lint` over the whole repo, the full `pnpm test` and the remaining check families are left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **The diff goes past the claim's declared file surface.** Every extra file is a direct consequence of the deletion:
  - the rows in `detailTimestamps.displayLocale-9786.test.tsx`, which import two deleted components;
  - two `components` test comments and one `app-shell` test comment that named deleted files or components;
  - `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx`, which reds `check:doc-snippets` without the edit.
  - The i18n deletion also covers `DiffView`'s, `RecordNavigationEnhanced`'s and the `emptyValue` keys. The claim's parenthetical said the objectui#7163 keys only. The ruled deliverable is the keys only these components use, and measurement found these as well.
- **Pending changesets** `7163-detail-timestamp-i18n` and `9786-detail-timestamps-display-locale` describe work on `PointInTimeRestore` and `DiffView`, which will ship in the same release as their removal.
  - They are another author's declarations and are left untouched: `check-changeset-overwrite` reports none modified.
  - This PR's changeset carries a paragraph that reconciles the two for release-note readers.
  - `check:changeset-claims` lists 4 pending changesets that name a touched file. Each paragraph was read, and each is still accurate as a description of its own change.
- `ROADMAP.md` still lists `CommentInput` and `MentionAutocomplete` as done items. It is a historical checklist and is not edited here.
- The `plugin-detail.mdx` "Key Components" table does not list `RichTextCommentInput`, the composer that is actually mounted. Adding it would widen this PR, so it is not done.
